experiments.challenge: A tent becomes 100 after first successful quote

proposal.reason: Both experiments achieved the goal of purchasing 6 lights and 3 tents within the budget of 500. The first experiment used the initial policy and succeeded, while the second experiment tested a revision enabling quote refresh before ordering and also succeeded. Since the revision did not improve outcomes and both policies satisfied constraints, no change is required.
